reason: The frozen primary retained all finite positive source speed_m_s values and revealed an impossible maximum of 3752.402245 m/s. This sensitivity asks whether that source-data artifact materially determines the near-null entry-state coefficient.

citations: Tudorache et al. 2015 Frontiers in Physiology
DFO fish swimming performance database / CSAS 2024 summary

thresholds_m_s.role: closest permissive round threshold above the 2.26 m/s compiled eel record maximum
very permissive threshold, more than twice the compiled eel maximum
extremely permissive threshold used only to test sensitivity to gross source-speed artifacts

model: Identical to frozen within-link primary: min 5 unique fish per directed pair, fish-total weight 1, directed station-pair and project-year fixed effects, length/release timing adjustment, fish-clustered SE.
interpretation_rule: Do not replace the frozen primary. If all externally motivated cuts remain near 1 with intervals spanning 1, treat the within-link null as robust to gross implausible-speed artifacts. If conclusions shift materially, report the within-link result as source-speed-quality sensitive.
prohibited: do not select the threshold giving the preferred coefficient
do not redefine the frozen primary
do not claim the thresholds estimate a true ecological maximum speed
